description.en: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI（TUI）。

description.en: A Rust/ratatui terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.
description.zh: Rust/ratatui 终端客户端，直接使用 DSH SDK JSON-RPC 协议，支持独立运行或作为 profile bundle 加载。

description.en: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用，输入框里直接搜索并引用工作区文件。

description.en: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.
description.zh: 把鲸鱼娘思考时的 "deep diving" 状态文案自定义成任意你想要的样子。

description.en: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.
description.zh: OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑插件。

description.en: In-conversation generative UI: the model renders interactive HTML cards into the chat stream, with streaming preview and sandboxed rendering.
description.zh: 对话内生成式 UI：模型把交互式 HTML 卡片直接画进会话流，带流式预览与沙箱渲染。

description.en: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.
description.zh: 侧边栏集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。

description.en: A "focus chat" minimal view that shows only final outputs.
description.zh: 「聚焦会话」精简视图，只关注最终产出结果。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

description.en: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
description.zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。

description.en: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.
description.zh: 对话节点导航条，右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息。

description.en: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: 右侧用户消息导航条，根据消息数量与可用高度自适应排布导航块，并支持悬停预览、键盘操作与点击跳转。

description.en: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.
description.zh: 后台任务状态条：对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。

description.en: Animated blue-whale desktop pet with per-session response progress, model activity and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.
description.zh: 蓝鲸桌面宠物：按会话实时展示回答进度、模型动作与工具调用轨迹、token、输出速率与耗时，并支持多会话状态卡片展开和收起。

description.en: Collapse noisy messages (Think, Bash, etc.) in conversations.
description.zh: 折叠对话中的 Think、Bash 等「无用消息」。

description.en: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。

description.en: Document reading mode for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 文档阅读模式。

description.en: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.
description.zh: 跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入，无需复制文件。

description.en: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.
description.zh: 从 Web 输入框上传任意本地文件，以待发送卡片展示，并在设置中管理已存文件。

description.en: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.
description.zh: `?session=` / `?workspace=` 深链直达指定项目对话。

description.en: PiUI-style diff viewer replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls.
description.zh: PiUI 风格 diff 查看器，替换 write/edit 工具调用的默认 DiffBlock。

description.en: Settings extensions for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 的设置扩展。

description.en: Web Components support.
description.zh: Web Components 支持。

description.en: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 对话轮次导航。

description.en: Right-side dot-timeline rail: jump between user messages.
description.zh: 右侧圆点时间轴导航条，点击跳转到任意用户消息。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and session cost in the composer dock, with auto-fetched official pricing and peak/off-peak support.
description.zh: 输入框 dock 显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与会话花费，自动拉取官方定价，支持高峰/低谷计价。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly windows with reset countdowns) in the composer dock, with a built-in credential editor.
description.zh: 在输入框上方 dock 显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（5h 滚动/每周/每月窗口与重置倒计时），内置凭据编辑器。

description.en: Per-session and daily API cost, budget with usage %, official balance, history dashboard, and one-click official price sync with peak/off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 会话与当日 API 费用统计、预算图框（已用%）、官方余额、历史看板，支持峰谷计价与官方价格一键同步。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance, balance trend, and daily usage charts in DSH Web settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中展示 DeepSeek API 余额、余额趋势与每日用量图表。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 DeepSeek API 余额与最近 24 小时用量，包括估算消费、Token、请求次数和按小时时间线。

description.en: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。

description.en: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

description.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
description.zh: 一键收起会话中所有展开的区块（Think、工具卡等），常驻计数按钮 + 自定义快捷键。

description.en: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.
description.zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

description.en: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
description.zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

description.en: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：精灵图动画、agent 状态联动、拖拽、闹钟（每天/一次）与番茄钟，皮肤下拉选择 + 预览。

description.en: Adds a built-in plugin catalog to DSH Web with search, status explanations, and safe toggles for audited UI plugins.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加官方内置插件目录、搜索与状态说明，并提供经过审核的安全 UI 插件开关。

description.en: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.
description.zh: Solarized 浅色主题、紧凑布局、思考/工具链折叠胶囊，以及余额、本轮成本与用量看板的 DSH Web 界面增强插件。

description.en: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.
description.zh: HUD 状态面板：Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能列表、模型与 token 用量，悬浮侧栏一览无余。

description.en: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。

description.en: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.
description.zh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。

description.en: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.
description.zh: DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击：Codex 风格行内打开、文件管理器定位、回合尾部文件 chip 列表。

description.en: DeepSeek API spend (current session and all sessions) and account balance in the aside panel, with official pricing and peak/off-peak support.
description.zh: 右侧面板展示 DeepSeek API 费用（当前会话 + 全部会话累计）与账户余额，内置官方计价与峰谷计价支持。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and per-session cost card in the sidebar foot.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部 DeepSeek 账户余额显示与会话费用估算卡片。

description.en: File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.
description.zh: 拖放 fork：文档以可删除「文件芯片」挂在输入框上方，不打字也能发送。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

description.en: Persistent left-hand conversation outline: questions and final replies per turn, keyword filter, one-click jump.
description.zh: 对话栏左侧常驻大纲：按轮次列出提问与最后回复，支持关键词过滤与一键跳转。

description.en: Per-request model token usage tracked to per-day JSONL files, with a stats page in Web settings: daily trend chart, per-model breakdown, and date/model filters.
description.zh: 按请求持久化模型 token 用量，Web 设置「Token 用量」统计页：按日趋势图、按模型明细表、日期/模型筛选。

description.en: Codex-style skin switcher plus a custom wallpaper layer with opacity and blur controls.
description.zh: Codex 风格皮肤切换器 + 自定义壁纸层，可调透明度与模糊。

description.en: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).
description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

description.en: Fifteen curated theme families with complete light and dark palettes that follow the native Light, Dark, and Follow system modes.
description.zh: 15 个精选主题家族，浅深配色完整，跟随 DSH 原生浅色/深色/跟随系统模式。

description.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.
description.zh: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。

description.en: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.
description.zh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

description.en: Share your conversations with one click.
description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。

description.en: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
description.zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

description.en: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
description.zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

description.en: Share any excerpt of a conversation.
description.zh: 分享任意段落的对话。

description.en: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.
description.zh: 本地优先学习模式：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解。

description.en: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.
description.zh: 带实时预览的用户/内置 system prompt 分节编辑器。

description.en: Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).
description.zh: 让 dsh 和 Claude Code 会话直接互发消息，附带可点击的会话列表卡片（搜索/刷新/弹窗发送）。

description.en: Import Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode chat histories as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode 的聊天记录全保真导入为可续聊的 DSH 会话。

description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

description.en: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.
description.zh: 跨实例互联：经 interconnect 服务在多个 DSH 实例间转发消息与事件。

description.en: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
description.zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.
description.zh: 自动对话蒸馏：后台 subagent 反省 + 技能 create/update。

description.en: Deep Mnemon integration: local three-tier memory (Runtime Memory, retrievable Documents, supervised Memory Spaces).
description.zh: Mnemon 深度集成：本地三层记忆（Runtime Memory、可检索 Documents、受监督 Memory Spaces）。

description.en: Cross-session memory: SQLite with a human-editable Markdown mirror, background consolidation (dedup, merge, conflict resolution), and six memory tools.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：SQLite + 可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像，后台自动巩固（去重/合并/冲突裁决），提供 6 个记忆工具。

description.en: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.
description.zh: 给所有 AI 工具和 Agent 共用的一层记忆：注入 Context Bundle、提示时检索、MCP 工具与回合结束 DSH 线程捕获。

description.en: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 无损会话日志的引用式记忆：蒸馏出的事实带 `(sessionId, eventRange)` 引用，可随时展开回原始日志片段。

description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

description.en: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.
description.zh: 动作-状态时序记忆：记录类型化的状态与动作，做趋势、异常与因果关联分析。

description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection; every write passes the approval gate and stays reconstructable from the session log.
description.zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：`ctx.memory` 服务 + 零依赖 SQLite 存储 + `memory` 工具与冻结快照注入；写入必过审批门，模型可见内容可自会话日志重建。

description.en: File-backed working memory: memorize/recall key premises verbatim in a session notes file so they survive context compaction losslessly.
description.zh: 文件型工作记忆：memorize/recall 把关键前提逐字保存在会话笔记文件，无损挺过上下文压缩。

description.en: Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.
description.zh: 全局知识库桥：kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline 读写与 Codex 共享的 D:\knowledge（格式逐字节兼容）。

description.en: Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.
description.zh: 压缩后前提漂移守卫：摘要丢失关键字面锚点时注入一次性提醒。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: Project-scoped cross-session memory: PROJECT.md snapshot injected into the first user message, a memory_remember tool, and auto-reflection after ReAct tasks; each project keeps its own memory file.
description.zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：PROJECT.md 快照注入首条用户消息（缓存友好）+ memory_remember 工具 + ReAct 任务结束自动反思；各项目独立记忆文件，互不互通。

description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。

description.en: Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools (works even when DSH fails to boot).
description.zh: DSH 撤销/回退系统：配置变更自动存档，一键撤销/恢复/回退到任意版本，支持 WebUI 与离线 CLI/GUI 工具（DSH 启动失败也能救）。

description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

description.en: Vision tasks for text-only models: intent-aware image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI reproduction, grounding, and pixel diff.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型更好地做视觉任务：带意图的图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原等。

description.en: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.
description.zh: 用 Monaco 编辑器创建和管理沙箱化的自定义 JavaScript 工具。

description.en: Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
description.zh: macOS 电脑控制：Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。

description.en: Android GUI Agent with ADB screenshots, compact UI hierarchy grounding, verified iterative actions, approvals, and a Mobile Web view.
description.zh: Android GUI Agent：ADB 截图、压缩 UI hierarchy 定位、逐步动作验证、审批和 Mobile Web 视图。

description.en: Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.
description.zh: 让 AI 帮你连数据库、写 SQL。

description.en: Zero-dependency toolkit: time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema — ten deterministic tools in one install.
description.zh: 零依赖工具包：time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema 十件套一键安装。

description.en: Remote workspace: connect a host over SSH (password or key), pick a remote workspace directory and operate on it with rw_pick_workspace / rw_list_dir / rw_read_file / rw_exec tools.
description.zh: 远程工作区：SSH 密码或 key 连接远程主机，选取远程工作区目录，用 rw_pick_workspace / rw_list_dir / rw_read_file / rw_exec 工具在远程直接操作。

description.en: Parse/query/aggregate/convert CSV (RFC 4180) with a zero-dependency state-machine parser.
description.zh: CSV 解析/查询/统计/转换（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器。

description.en: Safe math expression evaluator, zero-dependency recursive-descent parser.
description.zh: 安全的数学表达式求值器，零依赖递归下降解析器。

description.en: Structured comparison and unified diffs for text/JSON/CSV/Markdown.
description.zh: 文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff。

description.en: base64/url/hex encoding, common hashes, and UUID generation.
description.zh: base64/url/hex 编解码、常用哈希、UUID 生成。

description.en: JSON queries with a JMESPath subset.
description.zh: JMESPath 子集 JSON 查询。

description.en: HTML↔Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, and TOC generation.
description.zh: HTML↔Markdown 转换、GFM 表格规范化、目录生成。

description.en: Test/extract/safe-replace/statically explain regexes without executing code.
description.zh: 正则测试/提取/安全替换/静态解释（不执行代码）。

description.en: JSON Schema validation: validate/paths/explain/normalize.
description.zh: JSON Schema 验证：validate/paths/explain/normalize。

description.en: Descriptive statistics, percentiles, frequency distributions, and correlation.
description.zh: 描述统计/百分位数/频数分布/相关性。

description.en: Strict ISO 8601 parsing, IANA timezone conversion, and UTC calendar arithmetic.
description.zh: 严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算。

description.en: Build auditable KB packs (SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval and original-text reading.
description.zh: 从 md/txt/docx/pdf 构建可审计知识库包（SQLite FTS5），确定性检索与原文阅读。

description.en: Expose MineRU document parsing tools to the model.
description.zh: 向模型暴露 MineRU 文档解析工具。

description.en: Bounded, cell-addressed `doc_read`/`doc_write` for xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb, plus an MCP server and CLI.
description.zh: doc_read/doc_write：以有界、单元格寻址的方式读写 xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb，另附 MCP 服务器与 CLI。

description.en: Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.
description.zh: 把已有的 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）技能库带进 DSH：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录、注入渐进式索引，按需加载技能正文。

description.en: Project .pack.json/.pack.zip into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.
description.zh: 把 .pack.json/.pack.zip 投影到 .agent-pack/modpacks/，按工作区白名单暴露 skill。

description.en: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.
description.zh: 按 agent 的按需工具发现与渐进式 schema 披露。

description.en: OpenMAIC: classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.
description.zh: OpenMAIC 教学：课堂、幻灯片、交互组件与苏格拉底式教学。

description.en: Academic assistant plugin.
description.zh: 学术助手插件。

description.en: Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.
description.zh: 文本卫生 dsh 插件：净化不可信文本、扫描隐形字符、清洗 LLM 格式、转义 CSV 公式注入。

description.en: Xcode AI integration for DSH: 26 Xcode MCP tools (mcpbridge) + Apple platform skills + Xcode Intelligence-style persona (agent preset or global bundle).
description.zh: DSH 的 Xcode AI 集成：26 个 Xcode MCP 工具（mcpbridge）+ Apple 平台技能 + Xcode Intelligence 风格 persona（agent preset 或全局 bundle）。

description.en: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.
description.zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。

description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.
description.zh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 `dsh-plugin` 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).
description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

description.en: The plugin market inside DSH: a Settings page to browse and search the full community catalog by category, with confirmed one-click installs and an installed-plugins view.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件市场：设置页内逛/搜全部社区插件，按分类筛选，确认后一键安装，已装插件一目了然。

description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

description.en: Indexes workspace symbols with Tree-sitter and provides lexical or optional embedding-assisted code search.
description.zh: 用 Tree-sitter 建立工作区符号索引，提供词法或可选 embedding 辅助的代码检索。

description.en: Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.
description.zh: 子代理委派的按调用覆盖：model/provider/persona/toolFilter、@preset: 引用与 provider/model 组合 id。

description.en: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents, shipped with the two in-process provider patches it requires.
description.zh: 在 dsh-subagent-tools 基础上增加子代理按调用 cwd，附带所需的两个 in-process provider 补丁。

description.en: Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.
description.zh: 语音输入、语音输出：把口述音频转写为用户消息（transcribe），让 agent 朗读回复（speak），本地优先，音频存于 ~/.dsh/voice。

description.en: Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.
description.zh: 类型安全、带护栏的容器控制：ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop 与 compose up/down，JSON 输出、项目感知定位、破坏性操作需审批。

description.en: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。

description.en: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.
description.zh: 按需取回薄层：context_query / context_slice / context_grep 三个工具读取已持久化的历史，引用可回放。

description.en: Export DSH conversations as Smartisan Notes-style PNGs, or create and update Markdown notes in a configured account-scoped workspace.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为锤子便签风格 PNG，或在配置的账号工作区中新建和更新 Markdown 便签。

description.en: Compile SVG paths and keyframe specs into self-contained Lottie JSON animation files.
description.zh: 将 SVG 路径与关键帧参数编译成自包含的 Lottie JSON 动画文件。

description.en: Query 64 Chinese exams (高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…) with rule-aware date math (2nd-Saturday, 1st-Sunday) and countdowns.
description.zh: 查询 64 场中国考试（高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…）的规则日期（第二个周六、第一个周日）与倒计时。

description.en: Recurring-habit scheduling from pure date math: next occurrence, range schedules, and overdue advice.
description.zh: 基于纯日期数学的周期习惯排程：下次发生日、区间排程与逾期提醒。

description.en: ADHD behavioral coaching skill: task breakdown, overwhelm management, launch rituals, and failure recovery.
description.zh: ADHD 行为辅导技能：任务拆解、事项过载管理、启动仪式与失败重启。

description.en: Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.
description.zh: 多引擎反向识图聚合：Google Lens、百度、Yandex、TinEye、SauceNAO、IQDB、Ascii2d。

description.en: Detect and download media from Bilibili/YouTube/Douyin/Xiaohongshu with quality and format analysis.
description.zh: 检测并下载 B站/YouTube/抖音/小红书视频媒体，带清晰度与格式分析。

description.en: A read_graph tool backed by a codebase knowledge graph (CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL relations).
description.zh: 基于代码库知识图谱的 read_graph 工具（CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL 关系）。

description.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。

description.en: Search built for agents: multilingual coverage across web, academic, code, shopping, finance, news, and encyclopedias.
description.zh: 专为 agent 打造的搜索工具：多语言，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。

description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.
description.zh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。

description.en: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DSH operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required.
description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏扩展，让 DSH 直接操控你的浏览器，无需视觉能力。

description.en: In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 内的社区插件市场：浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 目录，从 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 安装/卸载插件到 profile。

description.en: Browser automation (Playwright) with a live view, an MCP server exposing DSH agents to any MCP client, and GitHub issue/PR/webhook review tools.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化（Playwright，带实时画面）+ MCP Server（把 DSH agent 暴露给任何 MCP 客户端）+ GitHub issue/PR/webhook 评审工具。

description.en: ADB device & bench operations for DSH: device discovery, structured logcat (background streaming), apk install, file pull/push, and dumpsys performance snapshots.
description.zh: ADB 设备·台架运维工具集：设备发现、结构化 logcat（后台采集）、apk 安装、文件 pull/push、性能快照。

description.en: One-command backup of DSH user data: /backup, scheduled auto-backup, sha256 checksums and rotation.
description.zh: 一键备份 DSH 用户数据：/backup 命令、定时自动备份、sha256 校验与自动轮换。

description.en: Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.
description.zh: Hermes 风格工具搜索与瘦身：渐进式披露，语义搜索/查看/调用长尾工具，核心工具保持直通。

description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

description.en: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader plugin), via a `picgo_upload` tool and a `/picgo` command.
description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

description.en: Skills for building websites on the Creght platform: CLI pull/push sync, page and component conventions, CMS, forms, auth, SEO, publishing and version rollback.
description.zh: Creght 平台建站技能包：CLI 拉取/推送同步、页面与组件规范、CMS、表单、Auth、SEO、发布与版本回滚。

description.en: UltraCode-style multi-agent orchestration: a generatable, savable, governable, observable, resumable workflow layer.
description.zh: 把 UltraCode 式多 Agent 调度带给 DSH：可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。

description.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.
description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

description.en: Scheduled coding runs in fresh agent sessions with auditable history.
description.zh: 定时任务：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，保留可审计历史。

description.en: Settings-based scheduled tasks that run on time or during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with one-time and daily schedules backed by durable task state.
description.zh: 设置页定时任务：支持准点或 DeepSeek 谷时段执行、单次/每日重复，并持久化任务状态。

description.en: Scheduled agents on a cron: run a prompt on a schedule and get the digest where you already are, with overlap/missed-run/timeout safety defaults.
description.zh: 定时 Agent：按 cron 计划运行 prompt，把摘要送到你已有的地方，内置重叠/漏跑/超时安全策略。

description.en: Plan review with anchored annotations and structured feedback back to the agent.
description.zh: 计划批注：选中计划原文逐条批注，结构化反馈送回 Agent。

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description.zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

description.en: Condition-driven wakeup: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent.
description.zh: 条件驱动唤醒：file/command/http/process/webhook 持久监视，触发即唤醒 agent。

description.en: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator built on the official workflow engine.
description.zh: 自适应深度研究编排器（基于官方 workflow 引擎）。

description.en: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop toolset.
description.zh: 发现问题→修复交付→质量复查的对抗式闭环工具集。

description.en: Embedded task management engine: decision-point protocol, idea capture wall, Linear-style issue store.
description.zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎：决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储。

description.en: Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
description.zh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。

description.en: Independent read-only acceptance layer: spawns a read-only verifier before each top-level turn closes and steers non-pass gaps back into the agent.
description.zh: 独立只读验收层：顶层 turn 收尾前 spawn 只读 verifier，未通过时把缺口注回主 agent。

description.en: Engineering-discipline guard: grill the requirements before the first edit, enforce red/green test evidence gates, and audit the delivery with a forked adversary (grill-requirements skill + tool-policy gates).
description.zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审（grill-requirements 技能 + 工具策略门）。

description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.
description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。

description.en: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
description.zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
description.zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in VS Code directly from the web GUI.
description.zh: 从 Web GUI 一键在 VS Code 中打开工作区目录。

description.en: Desktop notifications for turn completions, with per-outcome controls and keyword rules.
description.zh: 回合完成桌面通知，按结果分控 + 关键词过滤。

description.en: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.
description.zh: BitFun 与 DSH 的 ACP 交互对接。

description.en: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
description.zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

description.en: Bridge to the Telegram Bot API: long polling, per-chat sessions, HTML formatting.
description.zh: Telegram Bot API 桥接：长轮询、per-chat 会话、HTML 格式化。

description.en: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via the iLink gateway: text both ways, session targeting, digest heartbeats, and numbered approval prompts.
description.zh: 通过 iLink 网关在微信里与 DSH agent 聊天、监控与审批：双向文本、会话切换、进度摘要与编号审批提示。

description.en: Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.
description.zh: 会话完成等四种状态的通知响应，支持浏览器提示。

description.en: Desktop notification reminders.
description.zh: 桌面通知提醒。

description.en: DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.
description.zh: DSH 结合 Kimi WebBridge。

description.en: Two-way WeChat (iLink) bridge: turn-end and approval-request push, in-chat approve/reject and message injection, persistent dedup and convergent long-reply chunking; channel layer extensible to other IMs.
description.zh: 微信（iLink）双向桥：turn 完成/批准请求推送、聊天内批准与消息注入、持久去重与长回复收敛分段；通道层为多 IM 预留。

description.en: Bidirectional Lark/Feishu controller for DeepSeek Harness with project and session routing, interactive cards, approvals, attachments, and task controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向控制器，支持 Project 与 Session 路由、交互卡片、审批、附件和任务控制。

description.en: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: Adaptive model routing: per-request complexity classification with automatic provider routing.
description.zh: 自适应模型路由：请求级复杂度分类，按配置链自动选择后端 provider。

description.en: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
description.zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

description.en: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

description.en: Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.
description.zh: 把本机 Codex / Grok / Claude / OpenCode / CC Switch 登录态导入 DSH，在设置里自选来源并启用模型。

description.en: Qwen multi-modal plugin support.
description.zh: Qwen 多模态插件支持。

description.en: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
description.zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

description.en: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
description.zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

description.en: Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all `git config` settings.
description.zh: git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份，环境变量注入压过一切 `git config` 设置。

description.en: Context injection audit: token costs of instruction chains / skill catalogs / tool schemas, duplicate and conflict detection.
description.zh: 上下文注入审计：统计指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突。

description.en: Enforced pain-point gate: after two non-converged experiments it injects the three questions, denies non-investigative tool calls until answered, and blocks same-direction retries.
description.zh: 强制痛点检查：同一问题连续 2 个实验未收敛后注入三问、拦截非调查类工具调用直到答出、阻止同方向重试。

description.en: Plugin health checks: manifest protocol / patch format / build traps, zero-dependency and read-only.
description.zh: 插件健康检查：扫描清单协议/patch 格式/构建陷阱，零依赖只读。

description.en: Local security audit: config, plugin origins, sessions, network exposure — read-only redacted risk report.
description.zh: 本机安全审计：配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，只读脱敏风险报告。

description.en: Frame-level scan diagnostics for session files (torn/corrupt/empty detection).
description.zh: 会话文件帧级扫描诊断（torn/损坏/空会话检测）。

description.en: Self-evolution: the agent hot-mounts/removes persistent plugins on itself mid-session.
description.zh: 自进化：agent 在会话内给自己热挂载/卸载持久化插件。

description.en: Telemetry backend exporting turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace.
description.zh: 遥测后端：把 turns、model steps、tool calls 导出到 yiTrace。

description.en: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
description.zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

description.en: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
description.zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

description.en: Support for the microsandbox backend.
description.zh: microsandbox 沙箱支持。

description.en: Microsoft cross-platform sandbox support.
description.zh: 微软跨平台沙盒支持。

description.en: Support for the nono sandbox backend.
description.zh: nono 沙盒支持。

description.en: Agent-tree token budget management.
description.zh: agent 树 token 预算管理。

description.en: The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.
description.zh: DSH 的模型切换器：指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，内置精选免费/低价 DeepSeek 服务商预设，免费额度限流时自动回退。

description.en: Manual approval mode ("Manual Mode" / "Ask Mode").
description.zh: 手动审批模式（Manual/Ask Mode）。

description.en: Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching `danger-full-access` escalations only for the current task, then expire.
description.zh: DSH「允许本次任务」临时授权：仅在当前任务内自动放行同类 `danger-full-access` 请求，任务结束自动失效。

description.en: Plugin template repo (based on the official turtle-ui repo).
description.zh: 插件模板仓库（基于 turtle-ui 官方仓库）。

description.en: A TPS metrics plugin.
description.zh: TPS 指标插件。

description.en: Per-process tool-call statistics: a `tool_stats` tool reporting per-tool call counts, error counts, and average durations.
description.zh: 进程内工具调用统计：提供 `tool_stats` 工具，按工具汇报调用次数、失败次数与平均耗时。

description.en: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
description.zh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

description.en: Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.
description.zh: DSH 插件评测框架：YAML 用例驱动真实 headless agent，断言工具调用/参数/返回与 token 用量，baseline 门禁做 CI 回归。

description.en: Community distribution: TUI, desktop, and Web UI as one bundle with layered installation.
description.zh: 社区发行版：TUI、桌面端与 Web UI 统一体验，分层安装、一步到位。

description.en: Select browser elements directly during Vibe Coding and send structured visual feedback to the DeepSeek Harness Agent.
description.zh: 面向 Vibe Coding 的浏览器元素标注插件：直接选取页面元素，并将结构化视觉反馈发送给 DeepSeek Harness Agent。

description.en: Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn model selection, argument substitution, and state restoration.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 可复用 Markdown Prompt Profile，支持单轮模型选择、参数替换和状态恢复。

description.en: Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。

description.en: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
description.zh: 增加需要审批的 Git 状态、diff、日志、提交、分支和可选检查点工具。

description.en: Adds dangerous-operation policy checks, output redaction, and a security-review workflow.
description.zh: 增加危险操作策略检查、输出脱敏和安全审查工作流。

description.en: The `dsh pm` plugin manager: multi-source search (awesome list + GitHub + npm), install/remove/update per profile, and a doctor audit of manifests, bundle patches, and version drift.
description.zh: `dsh pm` 插件管理器：多源搜索（awesome 列表 + GitHub + npm）、按 profile 安装/移除/更新，以及 doctor 审计（清单、bundle patch、版本漂移）。

description.en: Take control of your tmux panes: list/send-keys/capture, run long jobs in a pane with watch mode, and approval-gated destructive commands.
description.zh: 掌控你的 tmux 面板：list/send-keys/capture、在面板中运行长任务并 watch，破坏性命令需审批。

description.en: DSH self-updater in the settings page: one-click check/pull (`git pull --ff-only`), auto background checks, version diff and changelog preview with a red-dot reminder.
description.zh: 设置页中的 DSH 自助更新器：一键检查/拉取（git pull --ff-only）、自动后台检查、版本对比与更新说明预览，带红点提醒。

description.en: /repro exports a minimal, secret-scrubbed, replayable problem bundle: the session log, failed commands, and Git diff.
description.zh: /repro 导出最小可复现问题包：去 secret 的会话日志、失败命令与 git diff。

description.en: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: connection status, registered tools, errors, and reconnect counts through the /mcp command and a Settings tab, with sanitized display and enable/disable patch suggestions.
description.zh: 官方 MCP 客户端（dsh-mcp-client）的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令与设置页 MCP 页签展示连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数，脱敏展示并提供启停 patch 建议。

description.en: Compare multiple skills on the same task and pick the winner.
description.zh: 同一任务并行试跑多个技能，对比结果选出最优。

description.en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin development.
description.zh: 插件生态基建：浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。

description.en: Run the dsh runtime on Multica.
description.zh: 让 dsh 运行时跑在 Multica 上。

description.en: Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.
description.zh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题：自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。

description.en: Per-model token cost tracking with configurable cache-hit/miss, output and peak-window pricing, a live session cost bar, and unconfigured-model flags.
description.zh: 按模型追踪 token 成本：可配置缓存命中/未命中、输出与高峰时段单价，实时会话花费条，并标记未配置价格的模型。

description.en: Login gateway for the DSH web UI: password door with first-run setup, bcrypt + at-rest encryption (AES-256-GCM/HMAC), brute-force lockout, audit log, TLS 1.2+ with 80→443 redirect, CSRF, anti-framing.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 登录网关：首次配置、bcrypt + 静态加密（AES-256-GCM/HMAC）、防爆破、审计日志、TLS 1.2+ 与 80→443 跳转、CSRF 与防嵌框。

description.en: WebUI authentication enforced at the HTTP/transport layer: four-layer login gate (resources, plugin bundles, /api, WebSocket), server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies.
description.zh: WebUI 身份认证：HTTP/传输层强制登录（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 四层防护），服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie。

description.en: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
description.zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

description.en: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.
description.zh: 2005 年中文站点风格的整活广告插件：侧栏广告/信息流/角落弹窗 + 假关闭叉，素材全虚构。

description.en: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.
description.zh: 与 AI 下五子棋，也可让 AI 对局比棋力。

description.en: Fixes the bug where your account can't lose money while you code.
description.zh: 有效解决了写代码的时候账户不能同时亏钱的 BUG。

description.en: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.
description.zh: 为 AI 回复自动添加表情。

description.en: Side-panel arcade: 18 offline mini-games to play while the model thinks.
description.zh: 右侧小游戏面板：18 款离线小游戏，等模型回复时的摸鱼神器。

description.en: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.
description.zh: 用户与 agent 双向表情贴纸互动。

description.en: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.
description.zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。

description.en: Append a thank-you note after every message. Mind your manners.
description.zh: 给每次消息后注入感谢语，做个有礼貌的人。

description.en: Pops up a mini-game menu (wordle, match-3, extensible) while the model generates.
description.zh: 模型生成时弹出小游戏菜单（wordle/消消乐，可扩展）。

description.en: Auto chess: human vs AI, or AI vs AI.
description.zh: 自走棋：人机对战或双 AI 对弈。

description.en: Short-video sidebar: native player, series navigation, precise history replay.
description.zh: 侧栏短视频：原生播放器、系列导航、精确历史回放。

description.en: Codex-style desktop pet: a floating animated sprite in the corner that mirrors the agent's running state (working, waiting, failed, done).
description.zh: Codex 风格桌面宠物：右下角悬浮动画精灵，随 agent 运行状态实时变化（工作、等待、报错、完成）。

description.en: Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cache, userscript-style extraction, Playwright rendering.
description.zh: 增强型、可持久化的网页搜索：多引擎路由（DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/B站/YouTube/V2EX/小红书/Twitter/Reddit/RSS）、SQLite+LRU 缓存、userscript 风格抽取、Playwright 渲染。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.
description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
description.zh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

description.en: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
description.zh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。
